description: This is a Java test class for SecurePay payment service integration, containing setup and test methods for authorization, capture, refund, and credit operations within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SecurePayServiceTest
classes.description: A JUnit test case class for testing SecurePay payment service operations such as authorization, capture, refund, and credit within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data including payment details, addresses, and payment preferences before each test.

methods.name: testAuth
methods.description: Tests the authorization process with SecurePay, verifying success and storing response details.

methods.name: testdoCapture
methods.description: Tests the capture operation after authorization, updating the response record.

methods.name: testdoRefund
methods.description: Tests the refund process, verifying success.

methods.name: testdoCredit
methods.description: Tests the credit (refund to card) operation, verifying success.
